newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - FHTK fully valued at S$0.60 - Kim Eng.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - FHTK fully valued at S$0.60 - Kim Eng.

text.p: Short-term investors should avoid subscribing to shares of FHTK Holdings Pte Ltd, a supplier of fruits and vegetables, Kim Eng Securities said on Tuesday.
FHTK is offering 96.4 million shares to the public and 24.1 million for private placement at Singapore $0.60 each in its initial public offer. The offer closes on January 16.

"At the prospective fiscal year 1997 (ending March) of 16 times, FHTK's valuation is similar to other trading companies, which are trading at an average prospective price earning ratio of 16.7 times. Investors without a long investment horizon should avoid the stock," said Kim Eng in its research report.

Kim Eng said FHTK was vulnerable to fluctuations in the supply of its agricultural produce, which is dependent on weather conditions and pest control although these risks are mitigated by the use of cold storage facilities.
The research house said the medium term outlook for FHTK was bright as global demand for fruits and vegetables would continue to grow with income and greater health consciousness.
